GOOD TO KNOW

One app. Different ways to write.

Android DIRECT WRITE

Use Chrome on an NFC-enabled phone. Turn NFC on, keep this app open, and hold one tag close.

iPhone & iPad COPY + WRITE

Copy your link here. In NFC Tools, choose Write → Add a record → URL / URI, paste it, then write your tag. iOS browsers cannot write NFC tags.

PC & Mac PREPARE LINK

Prepare and copy your link, then write it on a phone. Desktop writing requires a compatible USB NFC reader and separate native software.

Installing the app & choosing a tag +

iPhone: Open in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Android / desktop: use your browser’s Install app option when available.

Use a writable, NDEF-compatible NFC tag, such as an NTAG213, NTAG215, or NTAG216 with enough free capacity. Read-only tags cannot be rewritten. Test the tag after fitting it into your keychain; nearby metal can interfere.

The installed app can prepare links offline after its first successful load. Opening the link itself needs internet. Scanning a tag may show a notification that must be tapped; it does not automatically follow an account.
